Name: Bundle Viewer
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b]Bundle Viewer[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]Tooltips show needed bundles, hotkey opens bundle pages, donate from anywhere, shared multiplayer rewards.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50945/50945-1787181603-1898371516.png[/img][/center]
[line]
[center][b][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Item Tooltips[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Lists the bundles that need the hovered item, with the amount needed, grouped per room.[/*]
[*]Completed entries are hidden from the tooltip. [color=#b4a7d6](can be enabled in config to show a checkmark on completed items)[/color][/*]
[*]Checkboxes mark done state and quality stars show the required quality.[/*]
[*]Room names have the junimo note icon for visual clarity in tooltips.[/*]
[/list][table][tr][td][center][img width=643]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50945/50945-1787178969-125224498.png[/img][/center]
[/td]
[td][center][img width=622]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50945/50945-1787178973-738854607.png[/img][/center]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Bundle Tooltips[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Hover a bundle on the community center list to see its name and filled slot count.[/*]
[*]Shows the remaining required items, each with its checkbox and quality star.[/*]
[*]Completed bundles show a checked box.[/*]
[/list][table][tr][td][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50945/50945-1787178978-508599987.png[/img][/center]
[/td]
[td][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50945/50945-1787178977-278526452.png[/img][/center]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Quick Open[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Press the hotkey while hovering an item to open its bundle page.  [color=#b4a7d6](default B OR Mouse Middle)[/color] [/*]
[*]When the item is needed in several bundles, a bundle picker menu lets you choose between them.[/*]
[*]Pressing the hotkey on an item pulls the needed amount into your inventory first then opens the bundle. [color=#b4a7d6](if there's a picker menu it pulls them after choosing the bundle)[/color][/*]
[/list][center][img width=459]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50945/50945-1787178969-225970529.png[/img][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Remote Donation[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Donate to bundles from any location.[/*]
[*]The last donation that completes a bundle of a room must be made in that room. [color=#b4a7d6](generally prevents bugs and lets you watch the junimo cutscenes :D)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]A chat message announces when a completed bundle unlocks a new room.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Only unlocked rooms are listed by default. Turn it off to include locked rooms/bundles.[/color][/*]
[/list][b][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Multiplayer[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Every player can claim their own copy of a bundle reward from the community center bundle menu.[/*]
[/list][center][color=#674ea7][size=5][b]Modded Bundles are supported.[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/center]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6893][size=4][b]Community Center Helper[/b][/size][/url][/center]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51035][size=4]Tech's Cross-Mod Bundles[/size][/url][/center]
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
